newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire-Tyne extends losses on bid news.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire-Tyne extends losses on bid news.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire-Tyne extended earlier losses after the company said it welcomed as long a delay as possible by Granada on whether to launch a bid for Yorkshire.
Yorkshire's shares tumbled 30p to 1210p by 1239 GMT.
Granada already has a 24 percent stake in Yorkshire.
Earlier, Yorkshire's shares fell after the company released its first half results, and said its advertising revenues were below budget.
